sources.entry: Grimmory - Library for ebooks, comics and audiobooks with a built-in reader, metadata lookup, multi-user support, OPDS, and Kobo/KOReader sync. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: Grimmory is a self-hosted digital library for ebooks, comics, and audiobooks, with a built-in reader, metadata lookup, multi-user support, OPDS, and Kobo/KOReader sync.
summary.what_it_does: Grimmory provides a web-based library for managing ebooks, PDFs, comics, and audiobooks. It offers smart shelves with rule-based filtering, tagging, and full-text search. Metadata such as covers, descriptions, reviews, and ratings can be pulled from Google Books, Open Library, and Amazon, and edited. A browser reader handles PDFs, EPUBs, and comics with annotations, highlights, and progress tracking. Users can connect a Kobo, use OPDS-compatible apps, or sync progress with KOReader. Multiple users get separate shelves, progress, and preferences, with local or OIDC authentication. A BookDrop watched folder detects, enriches, and queues dropped files for import, and books can be sent to a Kindle, an email address, or another user.
use_cases: Reading EPUBs and PDFs in the browser
Syncing reading progress with Kobo or KOReader
Serving a library to OPDS reading apps
how_to_run: Create a .env file with database and app settings (see README Step 1)
Open the web UI on port 6060 and create an admin account
Create libraries only within host-mounted directories such as /books
notable: Built-in reader with annotations and highlights for PDFs, EPUBs, and comics
BookDrop folder that auto-detects and enriches incoming files
Kobo, OPDS, and KOReader sync support
DISK_TYPE=NETWORK mode disables destructive file operations for NFS/SMB mounts
Audiobook support for M4B, M4A, MP3, and OPUS
caveats: Requires Docker and a MariaDB database; the sample setup is a two-container deployment
In NETWORK disk mode, delete, move, and rename operations from the UI are disabled
Pull requests need a linked issue and maintainer approval before being opened, per the contributing rules
